author: J. P. Lesley (vocabularies obtained by Rev. Alexander Crummell)
journal: Proceedings of the American Philosophical Society
heading_as_printed: The following words were obtained by the Rev. Mr. Crummell, from a crowd of recaptured Africans, landed at Sino, in Liberia, about two hundred miles west of Cape Palmas.
about: Words taken by Alexander Crummell, with the help of interpreters, from about four hundred recaptured Africans landed from a United States war vessel at Sino, Liberia.
